getAllWithDetails.description: The employees with the name and city of their department and the name of their boss
getAllWithDetails.sql: SELECT e.*, d.name_dep, d.city, b.name_emp AS boss_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employees b ON b.employee_id = e.boss_id

getByIdWithDetails.description: An employee by its primary key, with the name and city of its department and the name of its boss
getByIdWithDetails.sql: SELECT e.*, d.name_dep, d.city, b.name_emp AS boss_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employees b ON b.employee_id = e.boss_id WHERE e.employee_id = $employee_id

endContract.description: RN07: ends the contract of an employee (its end date, today), only by its boss or, without boss, by the employee itself
endContract.sql: UPDATE employees SET end_date = CURDATE() WHERE employee_id = $employee_id AND end_date IS NULL AND (boss_id = $loggedId OR (boss_id IS NULL AND employee_id = $loggedId))

delete.description: RN07: deletes an employee, only by its boss or, without boss, by the employee itself
delete.sql: DELETE FROM employees WHERE employee_id = $employee_id AND (boss_id = $loggedId OR (boss_id IS NULL AND employee_id = $loggedId))
